typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

srcType.description: The entity type which this data diagnostic is running logic for.

description.description: High level description of what this data diagnostic is doing.

metricExpression.description:
The metric expression to evaluate. It will always evaluate over the last #interval.
The last result of the evaluation will be stored on the typeName's {@link #fieldName}.
Use window or other aggregation expressions to calculate over a larger range of time.

overrideSimpleMetrics.description:
Override simple metrics that the developer may optionally define and call
instead of seeded metrics.

overrideCompoundMetrics.description:
Override compound metrics that the developer may optionally define and
call instead of seeded metrics.

unit.description: The unit used in the metric evaluation of the diagnostic logic.

bindings.description: Bindings to use with any metrics invoked by the metric expression.

options.description: The {@link EvalMetricsOptions} to use when running the evalMetrics call.

requiredBindings.description:
Bindings which are required for the diagnostic to function properly.
This field should be overridden with a default for subtypes which only support metric-based diagnostics and always require certain bindings.

entitySpecificBindings.description: Field to override bindings for specific {@link #srcType} entities.

batchConfig.description:
{@link DataDiagnosticBatchConfig} for how this data diagnostic will be split into its own batches
or if it will be split at all.

interval.description: {@link Interval} used for the metric evaluation.

period.description: The period and interval should be the same because only the last data point of metric result is saved to the field.

timeZone.description: The timezone the used in the evaluation of the metric.

cronJob.description: The cron job which will run this data diagnostic logic on a set schedule.

filter.description: A filter used to retrieve entities of type `srcType` to run the data diagnostic logic on.

fetchInclude.description: Include string to within the {@link FetchSpec} if the diagnostic is configured to perform a fetch.

expression.description:
An {@link ExpressionEngineFunction} to apply on the entities of type `srcType` and within the
scope of the diagnostic. The entities which produce a truthy result from the expression will be
considered to hav satisfied the diagnostic logic.

All {@link DataDiagnostic}s on the same `srcType` which specify this field and have a filter
specifying the totality of instances of a type (i.e. `1==1`) should be batched together inside
the asynchronous jobs that process {@link DataDiagnostic}s so as to not scan the same table multiple times.

referentialIntegrityString.description:
A comma-separated list of field paths which should have their referential integrity checked. The field
paths should all end in a reference field to a type (a reference to a single instance of a type). Referential
integrity indicates that a reference field on the type or reachable from the type both has a reference
value and that reference value exists in the table it is a foreign key reference to.

Example string:
       referenceField0,referenceField1.referenceField2,collectionField[0].referenceField3
With this comma-separated list, referenceField0, referenceField2, and referenceField3 will all
be checked for referential integrity in their respective tables. And a positive result (tagging or alerting)
is considered to be the case when there is no referential integrity. In reality, this field gets parsed into
an {@link #expression} by attaching `meta.referenceInvalid` to the end of each comma-separated path.

enabled.description:
If enabled set to true then the data diagnostic will be evaluated inside of a Batch Job
that runs on the schedule denoted by {@link DataDiagnostic#cronJob}.

customDiagnosticLogic.description: Lambda function that can be used to override the existing logic on a type that extends {@link DataDiagnostic}.

fieldName.description:
The field on {@link #srcType} to store the metric result.
If the field is a {@link Dimension}, it will also store the {@link Timeseries#unit} to the field.

generatedByAnnotation.description: Whether this instance was generated because of an {@link Ann.MetricCache} annotation.

title: A way to configure a {@link FieldStoredMetricCacheBatchJob} to cache metric evaluations directly on a type's field.
name: FieldStoredMetricCache
